name: IELTS & TOEFL Training Assistance
benefit: - Financial aid of ₹3,10,000/- per student to cover IELTS and TOEFL training expenses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be a student and must have passed class 12th (HSC).1. The applicant should be residing in a notified tribal area of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must intend to pursue higher education abroad. 1. The applicant must require IELTS or TOEFL training as part of their admission preparation.
